items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: The Implementation-model field is removed for both codexIntegrationMode values, matching the operator's 'no exceptions' requirement and the confirmed product decision; spec.md FR-01.74 AC updated to match.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new error paths introduced; existing launcher fallbacks (no -c model= flag / DEFAULT_CODEXTENDER_MODEL_ALIAS) were already correct for an absent override and needed no change.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input handling, auth, or secret paths touched; this is a pure UI-field + client wiring removal.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Updated/added tests assert observable outcomes (field absent from the DOM, key absent from the launch POST body), not internal state; every re-targeted assertion still exercises real behavior (datalist population, disabled state) via a surviving field rather than being deleted outright.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No performance-relevant change; removes a render branch and a client-side conditional, net negative complexity.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All touched files stay under the 300-line guideline (largest is useNewIssueFormSubmit.ts at 253 lines); no new files added.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer (useNewIssueFormSubmit.ts's launch POST body) narrows by one optional field; consumer (server parse-body.ts) is unchanged and still tolerates its absence (pre-existing 'omits codexImplementationModel from the launch body when unset' behavior). Verified via payload-launch.codex-model.test.tsx's updated assertion plus the isolated-stack E2E run.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings across the changed test files.
